_readme: THE HAULOVER PORTAL -- a playable scene. You are at the helm of the Novurania 18 RHIB in the
Merrimack entrance on the afternoon ebb of 2026-08-28. Dead ahead, resting on the bed between
the jetty tips, is the Droste portal: the whole Earth as a 153 m globe, turned so the face
toward you is Baker's Haulover Inlet, Miami (toLat/toLon). The inner planet IS the root planet,
so an eye that dives in there re-roots at Haulover at full scale.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/haulover_portal.json
HELM   W / S  both throttles ahead / astern      A / D  steer to port / starboard
Q / E  split the levers (pivot)           Shift / Ctrl  trim out / in
T      leave the helm: the camera flies free (the boat keeps its throttles); T again returns
FLY    W A S D move, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look, wheel = speed.
Fly into the globe's west face: the speed follows the distance to the nearest ground,
and when that ground is the inner globe the frame re-roots -- you are over Haulover.
TIME   Space pause, Up / Down time x10 / /10, Left / Right nudge.   R reload shaders.
Live edits: save this file while it runs. The portal's `lighting` (realistic | appealing) and the
water's closures apply at once; the sea state, the destination and the portal's place need a
restart, and the log says which. The boat itself cannot pass through: the portal shrinks what enters it by
4.9 decades, and only the camera's scale floats (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 8).
